{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for missing values
print("Missing values per column:")
print(df.isnull().sum())

# Check unique values in customer_segment
customer_segments = df['customer_segment'].unique()
print(f"\nUnique customer segments: {customer_segments}")

# Check the distribution of converted
print(f"\nConversion rates by segment:")
print(df.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean())

# Check if 'loyal' is in the segments (case-sensitive?)
print(f"\nIs 'loyal' in customer_segment? {"loyal" in df['customer_segment'].values}")"}
